old_value: {"id":"mimid-1wgh.46.6.1","title":"haven: requestConsent cancel is answered 202 and never processed","description":"Found live (B4 step 6b), Haven 07ce96f. Wrong reading: Haven. protocol-07 §5.7 L2334-2344: requestConsent carries consentOperation request OR cancel ('or to cancel that request'; 'A cancel MUST use the same ConsentScope as a previous request'); L2368-2371: a cancel with no matching request gets 202 and no further action, so a cancel with a matching request is acted on. mimi-hubd/src/http.rs request_consent_wire (L648) lets cancel past the 422 check and calls Provider::process_request_consent (mimi-hubd/src/lib.rs L515), which bails on any operation other than request (L522: 'process_request_consent expects operation=request'); the error is dropped and 202 returned. Cancel is handled only in process_update_consent, which the wire updateConsent route never reaches for cancel (it answers 422, correctly per L2448-2450). So no wire request cancels a pending consent request. Live: requestConsent request then cancel for (alice@b.example, bob@haven, room live1) both 202; the hub's consent table still holds state 'requested' for that scope afterwards. For Haven: fix (route cancel on requestConsent to the delete), or document in DIVERGENCES.md, per their CONTRIBUTING.
